title: Pinch Grab
description: Pinch Grab is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Grabs a node with a pinch and holds it while the hand moves. A pinch is declared when thumb and finger tips come within 25 mm; the nearest node within the grab radius attaches to the hand. It takes hand tracking stream and produces grabbed node. Tunable parameters: grab radius 80 mm. Guarantee: only one node attaches per hand.

fields.mechanism: A pinch is declared when thumb and finger tips come within 25 mm; the nearest node within the grab radius attaches to the hand.
fields.guarantees: only one node attaches per hand

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Throw to Delete
description: Throw to Delete is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Deletes a node by throwing it — a fast fling off the workspace. Release velocity above the fling threshold on a grabbed node deletes it after a 1-second undo window. It takes grabbed node, release velocity and produces deletion with undo. Tunable parameters: fling threshold 2 m/s. Guarantee: deleted nodes are always restorable for 60 s.

fields.mechanism: Release velocity above the fling threshold on a grabbed node deletes it after a 1-second undo window.
fields.guarantees: deleted nodes are always restorable for 60 s

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Two-Hand Connect
description: Two-Hand Connect is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Draws an edge between two nodes by grabbing one in each hand and bringing them together. When two grabbed nodes come within the link distance, a provisional edge appears; releasing confirms it. It takes two grabbed nodes and produces new edge. Tunable parameters: link distance 100 mm. Guarantee: self-edges are never created.

fields.mechanism: When two grabbed nodes come within the link distance, a provisional edge appears; releasing confirms it.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Twist to Rotate
description: Twist to Rotate is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Rotates a node's orientation with a wrist twist while holding it. Twist angle maps 1:1 to node rotation about the view axis; the node shows a live angle readout. It takes grabbed node, wrist angle and produces rotated node. Tunable parameters: 1:1 mapping. Guarantee: rotation snaps to 15 degrees on release.

fields.mechanism: Twist angle maps 1:1 to node rotation about the view axis; the node shows a live angle readout.
fields.guarantees: rotation snaps to 15 degrees on release

title: Swipe to Dismiss
description: Swipe to Dismiss is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Dismisses a floating panel with a horizontal swipe. A swipe is a fast lateral hand motion over 150 mm; the panel follows the hand and fades on release. It takes panel, hand motion and produces dismissed panel. Tunable parameters: min swipe 150 mm. Guarantee: dismissed panels always offer an undo.

fields.mechanism: A swipe is a fast lateral hand motion over 150 mm; the panel follows the hand and fades on release.
fields.guarantees: dismissed panels always offer an undo

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Tap to Inspect
description: Tap to Inspect is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Opens a node's detail card with a single air-tap. A tap is a quick pinch-release under 300 ms aimed at a node; the card anchors beside the node. It takes node, tap event and produces detail card. Tunable parameters: tap under 300 ms. Guarantee: tapping empty space never opens a card.

fields.mechanism: A tap is a quick pinch-release under 300 ms aimed at a node; the card anchors beside the node.
fields.guarantees: tapping empty space never opens a card

title: Spread to Expand
description: Spread to Expand is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Expands a collapsed cluster node with a two-hand spread gesture. The spread distance maps to the cluster's expansion radius; child nodes bloom outward evenly. It takes cluster node and produces expanded children. Tunable parameters: radius 0.2–1.5 m. Guarantee: expansion never overlaps neighboring nodes.

fields.mechanism: The spread distance maps to the cluster's expansion radius; child nodes bloom outward evenly.

title: Flick to Send
description: Flick to Send is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Flicks a node toward another user to hand it over in shared space. A flick toward a collaborator's avatar transfers node ownership with a visible flight trail. It takes node, target avatar and produces transferred node. Tunable parameters: flick speed over 1.5 m/s. Guarantee: ownership transfers are always confirmed by the receiver.

fields.mechanism: A flick toward a collaborator's avatar transfers node ownership with a visible flight trail.

title: Hold for Menu
description: Hold for Menu is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Opens a radial menu by holding a grab on a node for one second. The hold timer shows a filling ring; at one second the radial menu blooms around the node. It takes grabbed node and produces radial menu. Tunable parameters: hold 1000 ms. Guarantee: the menu never opens on a quick grab.

title: Shake to Reset
description: Shake to Reset is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Resets the whole graph layout with a shake of both hands. Two-hand shake above the energy threshold triggers a layout animation back to the default arrangement. It takes hand motion stream and produces reset layout. Tunable parameters: energy threshold tuned. Guarantee: reset always asks for confirm on graphs over 50 nodes.

fields.mechanism: Two-hand shake above the energy threshold triggers a layout animation back to the default arrangement.

title: Draw to Link
description: Draw to Link is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Draws a freehand stroke between nodes to link them in a chain. The stroke is sampled and matched to the nearest nodes in order; each matched pair gains an edge. It takes stroke points and produces edge chain. Tunable parameters: match radius 60 mm. Guarantee: strokes matching fewer than 2 nodes create nothing.

fields.mechanism: The stroke is sampled and matched to the nearest nodes in order; each matched pair gains an edge.
fields.guarantees: strokes matching fewer than 2 nodes create nothing

title: Palm to Pause
description: Palm to Pause is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Freezes all gesture input by showing an open palm to the sensor. An open palm held for 500 ms toggles the input lock; the workspace shows a clear locked banner. It takes hand pose stream and produces input lock toggle. Tunable parameters: hold 500 ms. Guarantee: the lock never engages mid-drag.

fields.mechanism: An open palm held for 500 ms toggles the input lock; the workspace shows a clear locked banner.

title: Nod to Confirm
description: Nod to Confirm is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Confirms a destructive action with a head nod instead of a button. A nod is a vertical head oscillation detected while a confirm dialog is open; it acts as the confirm button. It takes head tracking, dialog state and produces confirmed action. Tunable parameters: 2 oscillations. Guarantee: nods outside a dialog never confirm anything.

fields.mechanism: A nod is a vertical head oscillation detected while a confirm dialog is open; it acts as the confirm button.
fields.guarantees: nods outside a dialog never confirm anything

title: Circle to Group
description: Circle to Group is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Circles several nodes with a finger to group them. The drawn loop's convex hull selects enclosed nodes; closing the loop creates the group. It takes finger path and produces node group. Tunable parameters: loop must close within 100 mm. Guarantee: single-node circles never create a group.

fields.mechanism: The drawn loop's convex hull selects enclosed nodes; closing the loop creates the group.
fields.guarantees: single-node circles never create a group

title: Voice Plus Gesture
description: Voice Plus Gesture is a interaction ability in the Gesture-Based Node Manipulation database. Combines a spoken command with a gesture, e.g. saying delete while pointing. The voice command sets the verb and the concurrent pointing gesture sets the target; both must overlap in time. It takes voice + gesture streams and produces combined command. Tunable parameters: overlap window 2 s. Guarantee: voice alone never triggers the destructive verbs.

fields.mechanism: The voice command sets the verb and the concurrent pointing gesture sets the target; both must overlap in time.
fields.guarantees: voice alone never triggers the destructive verbs
